第14章 中转站-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

时间紧，任务重。

王建新在暗处蹲了一会儿，把赛音山达的布局在脑子里过了一遍。国营商店已经扫过了，但这么大一个省会，不可能就那一个地方有物资。农牧场、火车站、物资局，这些地方肯定有仓库。

他站起来，沿着街道往北摸去。

转了半个多小时，终于让他找到了下一个目标。

一个国营农牧场的仓库。仓库不小，比国营商店那个大了一倍不止，外面停着几台拖拉机和各种农具，院子里堆着不少东西。

王建新在远处的墙角观察了一会儿。农牧场有值班的，屋里亮着灯，但人不多，就两三个。巡逻的也没有。

“全是我的。”王建新心里念叨着，悄悄绕到仓库后面。

贴着墙根，神识探进去——里面没人。意念一动，进空间，穿墙，进了仓库。

仓库里的味道冲鼻子。农药、化肥，一堆一堆的，摞得整整齐齐。旁边是种子——小麦种子、大麦种子、牧草种子，一袋一袋的，码了好几排。

王建新眼睛亮了。种子是好东西。空间里那么多空地，正缺种子呢。虽然他对种地不感兴趣了，但种点牧草喂牲口、种点粮食囤着，总没坏处。

除了种子，还有燃料。几大铁桶柴油汽油，靠在墙角。旁边是一堆备品备件，农机上用的零件，大大小小的，装在木箱子里。

另一块区域是维修工具。扳手、锤子、螺丝刀、钳子，各种型号的，还有润滑油、黄油、机油，一桶一桶的。

王建新站在仓库中间，神识放开，五米范围内的一切尽在掌握。

农药化肥——收。种子——收。柴油汽油——收。备品备件——收。工具——收。润滑油——收。

仓库里的东西一样没剩，全进了空间。

收完了，王建新穿墙出来，绕到仓库前面。

院子里停着几台拖拉机，还有各种型号的播种机、犁、耙。东西不错，苏联货，看着挺新。

但王建新蹲在暗处看了看，没敢动手。

院子里有值班室，灯亮着，里头有人。

“算了，先不要这些。”王建新心里盘算着，“拖拉机有的是，不差这几台。等以后有机会再说。”

他转身离开农牧场，往下一个目的地赶去。

这次的目标是铁路枢纽站。

赛音山达是个交通枢纽，铁路往南通往中国，往西北通往乌兰巴托，往东不知道通到哪儿。火车站肯定有仓库，而且规模不会小。

王建新摸黑走了将近一个小时，才摸到火车站附近。

火车站比他想的大。好几条铁轨并排着，停着几列货车。仓库沿铁路线排了一溜，大大小小的，有七八个。

但王建新趴在一堆木箱子后面观察了一会儿，心里咯噔了一下。

仓库区分两块。一块看样子是民用的，守卫松散，就门口有个老头看门。另一块就不一样了——围着铁丝网，门口有岗亭，有士兵站岗，里面还有巡逻的。仓库的建筑风格也不一样，更结实，更规整。

Time is tight and the task is heavy.

Wang Jianxin squatted in the dark for a while, going over Saiyinsanda's layout in his mind.The state-owned stores have been scanned, but in such a large provincial capital, it is impossible to have supplies in just that one place.Farms and ranches, train stations, and material bureaus must have warehouses in these places.

He stood up and walked north along the street.

After wandering around for more than half an hour, he finally found his next target.

A state-owned farm and ranch warehouse.The warehouse is not small, more than twice as big as the state-owned store. There are several tractors and various farm tools parked outside, and there are a lot of things piled in the yard.

Wang Jianxin observed in the far corner for a while.There are people on duty at the farm and ranch, and the lights are on in the house, but there are not many people, just two or three.Neither did the patrol.

"It's all mine." Wang Jianxin muttered to himself and quietly walked around to the back of the warehouse.

Sticking to the wall, my spiritual sense penetrated - there was no one inside.With a thought, he entered the space, passed through the wall, and entered the warehouse.

The smell in the warehouse is overwhelming.Piles and piles of pesticides and fertilizers, neatly stacked.Next to it are seeds—wheat seeds, barley seeds, grass seeds, bags after bags, stacked in several rows.

Wang Jianxin's eyes lit up.Seeds are good stuff.There are so many open spaces in the space, and we are short of seeds.Although he was no longer interested in farming, there was always no harm in growing some pasture to feed his livestock and growing some grain to store.

In addition to seeds, there is also fuel.Several large iron drums of diesel and gasoline were leaning against the wall.Next to it is a pile of spare parts, parts used in agricultural machinery, large and small, packed in wooden boxes.

Another area is for repair tools.Wrenches, hammers, screwdrivers, pliers, all types, as well as lubricants, butter, and engine oil, buckets after buckets.

Wang Jianxin stood in the middle of the warehouse, with his consciousness released and everything within five meters under his control.

Pesticides and fertilizers - Harvest.Seed - Harvest.Diesel and gasoline - collected.Spare parts - collected.Tools - collected.Lubricant - close.

Nothing in the warehouse is left, everything has gone into the space.

After finishing collecting, Wang Jianxin walked out through the wall and walked around to the front of the warehouse.

There are several tractors parked in the yard, as well as various types of planters, plows, and rakes.The stuff is good, made in the Soviet Union, and looks quite new.

But Wang Jianxin crouched in the dark and watched, but did not dare to take action.

There is a duty room in the yard, the lights are on, and there are people inside.

"Forget it, let's not get rid of these for now." Wang Jianxin thought to himself, "There are plenty of tractors, including these. Let's talk about it later when we have the opportunity."

He turned around and left the farm and rushed to his next destination.

This time the target is the railway terminal.

Sayinshanda is a transportation hub. The railway leads to China in the south, Ulaanbaatar in the northwest, and who knows where in the east.There must be a warehouse at the train station, and it will not be small.

Wang Jianxin walked in the dark for nearly an hour before reaching the vicinity of the train station.

The train station was bigger than he thought.Several railroad tracks ran side by side, and several trains of freight cars were parked.There are seven or eight warehouses lined up along the railway line, large and small.

But Wang Jianxin lay down behind a pile of wooden boxes and observed for a while, and his heart skipped a beat.

The warehouse is divided into two parts.One section seemed to be for civilian use, and the guards were loose. There was an old man guarding the door.The other area is different - surrounded by barbed wire, with a guard box at the door, soldiers standing guard, and patrols inside.The architectural style of the warehouse is also different, stronger and more regular.
